subject: Overtraining Keeps Mouse Hippocampal Dopamine Elevated Two Days After Exercise Ends
script: From Agewell Brief: Overtraining Keeps Mouse Hippocampal Dopamine Elevated Two Days After Exercise Ends. Exhaustive exercise disrupts dopamine clearance in the mouse hippocampus, locking wakefulness-promoting enzymes into overdrive long after physical exertion stops. Dedicated athletes often encounter a frustrating physical contradiction. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
